name: strands-ship
description: Ship a social-good agent with the Strands Agents SDK for the AWS Builder Center 'Strands SDK: Workshop to Ship' hackathon: set up, pick the strongest idea (a council of two frontier models picked HeatSafe Shift), build a Strands graph agent on Amazon Bedrock, label cases, measure against a one-prompt baseline, record the demo video from a live run, check the submission
